body_markdown:
Informa TechTarget (Nasdaq: TTGT), an indispensable partner for B2B intelligence, media, and marketing solutions, today announced that its AI-enhanced Buyer Intelligence solution is accessible via Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Now, B2B GTM organizations can integrate Informa TechTarget’s industry-leading, person-level intent data and behavioral insights directly into AI workflows powered by Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and custom AI systems. This enables B2B marketing and sales teams to build account battlecards, conduct account and market analyses, and craft personalized buyer outreach messages—all within their preferred AI workflows—based on the nuanced understanding of potential buyers’ specific[pain points](https://www.informatechtarget.com/press-release/informa-techtarget-launches-ai-driven-buyer-intelligence-solution-to-accelerate-b2b-gtm-workflows-with-actionable-person-level-intent-data-and-insights/) and research behaviors that only Informa TechTarget’s Buyer Intelligence provides.


This is the newest way in which Informa TechTarget is making it easier for customers to incorporate Buyer Intelligence into their GTM systems. In addition to Informa TechTarget’s Portal customer platform and now, AI workflows, flexible access options include direct connections to major marketing automation (MAP), customer relationship management (CRM), and account-based marketing (ABM) platforms, as well as AI-ready data clouds and other modern data stack solutions.


“We strive to be an indispensable partner to our customers, so we’ll continue to innovate to support their success as AI opens up new opportunities to drive even more value from our proprietary intent data and insights,” said Gary Nugent, Chief Executive Officer of Informa TechTarget. “Now our customers can seamlessly incorporate our uniquely rich intelligence to drive measurable growth with confidence and fuel their GTM success, whether they’re building an account strategy in Salesforce, analyzing buying patterns in Snowflake, or working with more advanced agent-led skills and workflows in tools like Claude.”


Earlier this month, Informa TechTarget announced the launch of AI capabilities—called Pain Points, Pitch Assist, and Persona and ICP Intelligence—within Buyer Intelligence, created specifically to deliver more personalized guidance and messaging to B2B GTM teams. Informa TechTarget’s Buyer Intelligence is derived from the directly observed actions of its global business and technology decision-maker audience—whose members generate millions of exclusive intent signals daily—based on the trusted expert guidance of Informa TechTarget’s award-winning editorial properties and BrightTALK webinar communities. By infusing this uniquely powerful person-level intent data directly into AI workflows, customers can transform these robust signals into actionable intelligence without switching between platforms or logging into separate systems.


“The combination of our purpose-built AI skills and this new accessibility via AI workflows really unlocks the power of our Buyer Intelligence in ways we haven’t been able to realize until now,” said Mark Picone, Chief Product and Technology Officer of Informa TechTarget. “By making our person-level intent data accessible via MCP server and other modern data infrastructure, we’re enabling our customers to build and enhance sophisticated, AI-driven GTM motions leveraging the richest buyer data available in B2B.”


Informa TechTarget has consistently been recognized as an industry leader in intent data, including recognition as a Leader and Customer Favorite in Forrester Wave™: Intent Data Providers For B2B, Q1 2025 (the most recent publication of this report); a Leader in the Frost Radar™: Account-Based Marketing Platforms; and a Leader in Research in Action’s Vendor Selection Matrix for Revenue Marketing Automation Platforms.


To learn more about Buyer Intelligence and the variety of ways it can be integrated into AI and GTM workflows, at[www.informatechtarget.com/products/buyer-intelligence/](https://www.informatechtarget.com/products/buyer-intelligence/) .


**About Informa TechTarget**


Informa TechTarget informs, influences and connects the world's technology buyers and sellers, and aims to be an indispensable partner in driving clients’ go-to-market success. With a vast reach of over 220 highly targeted technology-specific digital properties and approximately 58 million permissioned first-party audience members, Informa TechTarget has a unique understanding of and insight into the technology market.


As a leading provider of market intelligence, industry journalism, brand and demand marketing solutions, content strategy and creation, and exclusive buyer intent data, we deliver expert-led, data-driven, and digitally enabled services that create significant impact and measurable outcomes for our clients. All of this is underpinned by a unique audience data ecosystem and fueled by buyer insights and expertise.


Informa TechTarget is headquartered in Boston, MA and has offices in 19 global locations.
